entries.name: Vitriol Veins
entries.lore: Distilled volatile acid replaces your blood. Your strikes shatter stone; a stiff breeze shatters you.

entries.name: Cloven Sinew
entries.lore: Grafted tendon from a sacrificial beast. It never stops running, mostly because it is eating your vitality.

entries.name: Slag Carapace
entries.lore: Cooled furnace dross fused directly to the ribs. Heavy, crude, and deeply unpleasant to walk in.

entries.name: Spasmodic Nerve
entries.lore: Quicksilver injected into the spine makes your fingers twitch uncontrollably. Unfortunately, it also causes severe bodily swelling.

entries.name: Bellows Heart
entries.lore: Draws twice the aether into each cast. The resulting blast is magnificent, provided you survive the pause to vent the ash.

entries.name: Waxen Pinions
entries.lore: Feathers bound in boiling tallow. They carry you swiftly across the yard, dripping scalding wax down your neck.

entries.name: Parasitic Alembic
entries.lore: A living glass vessel that feeds on your flesh to engorge your projectiles. You become a much larger target.

entries.name: Lead Plumbum
entries.lore: Swallowing a two-pound sphere of base lead anchors the soul to the body, though it dulls the spark of your casts.

entries.name: Quicksilver Draught
entries.lore: Liquid metal thins the humors. Your hands blur with haste, though your organs are slowly dissolving.

entries.name: Astrologer's Ocular
entries.lore: A heavy brass reticle bolted to the brow. Reveals every fracture in the enemy's shell, at the cost of your peripheral vision and stride.

entries.name: Salt Effigy
entries.lore: Desiccates the body into a shrunken, harder-to-hit husk. Your strikes lose some weight along with your flesh.

entries.name: Pale Moon Covenant
entries.lore: Heresy against the Order. Your bolts burn with pale astral fire, your frame bloats with cold light, and a single mistake is fatal.

entries.name: Cinnabar Leech
entries.lore: A fat vermilion leech sealed in cracked glass. It drinks the last humor from anything you unmake, and your frame swells with the stolen vitae.
